description: Astana Synthetic Urban Traffic Congestion Benchmark (February–May 2026) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Beibut Amirgaliyev, Aidana Zhalgas (Astana IT University). A reproducible, city-scale synthetic benchmark for short-term urban traffic congestion forecasting, calibrated to the road network of Astana, Kazakhstan. Covers 100 virtual sensor locations (real OSM-derived positions; simulated speed/congestion values) at 15-minute resolution from 2026-02-01 to 2026-05-31 (11,520 time steps per sensor). Coverage: national (KZ); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
